 Order

This revision petition has been filed challenging the dismissal of an application for discharge in a prosecution under Section 59 r/w Section 3(1)(zz)(v) & (vii), Section 19, Section 26(1), 26(2)(i) and Section 27(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Section 59 r/w Section 3(1)(zz)(v) & (vii), Section 19, Section 26(1), 26(2)(i) and Section 27(1)
entities.label: PROVISION

sentences.text: 2. I have heard Sri.K.S.Babu, the learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri.Grashious Kuriakose, the learned ADGP.
The discharge application was filed after the charge was framed and when the case was posted for trial and summons was issued to the witnesses.
Once charge is framed, discharge application is not maintainable.
I see no merit in the revision petition and accordingly, it is dismissed with liberty to the petitioner to take up all the contentions raised in the discharge application during trial.

Sd/-
